name: metis-themes
description: Metis themes for Ghostty, iTerm2, Xcode, VSCode, Shiki, Vim, and PrismJS.

scripts.check:vim: vim --clean -Nu NONE -n -es -c 'set runtimepath^=$PWD' -c 'set background=dark' -c 'colorscheme metis' -c 'set background=light' -c 'colorscheme metis' -c 'qa!'
scripts.check: npm run check:generated && npm run check:json && npm run check:plist && npm run check:vim && npm run check:vscode
